title: Dawn of War 2 review (2009)
partialText: Space Marines, ding gratz lol.

title: We live in a world where every single Hatsune Miku is canon, which means that includes Helldivers Miku and Pyramid Head Miku
partialText: She's no longer just hiding in your wifi.

title: The design lead of Half-Life's biggest competitor says that its publisher was so 'pissed off' by the time the game launched that it didn't bother testing it properly: 'We got trashed in the press because of bugs'
partialText: "It really hurt it when it came to reviews."

title: A game developer compared Godot and Unity by making the same game in both engines, and he's found a clear winner
partialText: Godot is smaller, faster, and quicker to load than Unity, according to tests run by designer Thomas Grové.

title: Space Marine 2 gets a steep discount, a free trial and an update that adds a 'major revamp' of Siege Mode, as its multiplayer continues to outpace games like Marathon
partialText: The overhaul makes horde sessions "quicker and more intense".

title: I can't wait to get murdered by flowers in this rad-looking survival horror game
partialText: The Florist looks like Resident Evil meets Annihilation.

title: Keep your GTA 6, the news I can finally play the console-exclusive DLC for Saints Row 2 from 2009 on PC is what I've been waiting for
partialText: Bless the modders.

title: Jackbox's first externally published game looks like the shot in the arm the stealth genre needs, and it'll be out this year
partialText: Ha ha, get it, because it's called My Arms Are Longer Now.

title: A 23-year-old D&D CRPG just got patched to add achievements and fix a bug that stopped you from earning XP
partialText: Time to go back to The Temple of Elemental Evil.

title: Great moments in PC gaming: Stealing and selling someone else's treasure in Sea of Thieves
partialText: It's what the pirate life is all about.

title: Our readers are clear: They want Destiny 3, which is awkward, because Bungie reportedly isn't making Destiny 3
partialText: D'oh.

title: Kickstarter rolls back new mature content guidelines after week of backlash

title: 14 years ago we published our Elder Scrolls 6 wishlist, and honestly? It still holds up
partialText: Waiting on a hero (named Todd Howard).

title: Diablo 2 players made nearly 2 million warlocks in a single month

title: I'll never love another RPG like I loved Neverwinter Nights
partialText: Let me tell you about the time when I used to build worlds.

title: The best birding board game on PC is getting a sequel about dragons, which are like cooler birds
partialText: Roseate spoonbill son or shaly rockbreaker daughter?

title: Deadlock's latest 'small update' yet again remixes basic mechanics and rebalances most of the roster
partialText: It'll be harder to claim the soul urn without a fight, and the midboss spawns at match start.

title: PC Gamer's MMO readers are, according to you, fashion-forward healers who like your keybinds, and I couldn't be more proud
partialText: MMO to the polls.

title: As the UK plunges once more into political chaos, I’ve found the roguelike deckbuilder that can help me process it

title: A Broken Sword movie is in the works, aiming to move the adventure game classics into 'the next medium it deserves'

title: The Steam Controller's main competition isn't from Microsoft or Sony: It's from third-party vendors
partialText: Long gone are the days when third party was for player two.

title: You can help save the whales by buying this reef-building game written by the scribe of the Tomb Raider reboot

title: As it rapidly approaches $1 billion in player funding, Star Citizen goes free to play until May 27
partialText: No taxation, just representation.

title: The director of the best Splinter Cell game reckons that modern lighting engines are making stealth games 'so much harder to read'

title: Shock, tears, and relief: How Destiny 2's most popular creators reacted to the end of the legendary shooter
partialText: "I thought I would be ready to hear something like this, but I guess I'm just not," said popular streamer Datto.

title: Last Flag studio lays off half its employees as it puts 'the future of the game in the hands of our players'

title: Why play Wordle when you could be playing this new word puzzle game that rewards you with frogs?
partialText: It's Ribbit!

title: Four years later, Microsoft finally finishes fighting over the Activision acquisition
partialText: A lawsuit suit, filed by Sjunde AP-Fonden, alleged that the buyout was rushed in order to protect Activision's then-CEO Bobby Kotick.

title: EU politician says killing games is bad, but 'wokeness' and the Black samurai Yasuke are the real problem

title: Alright, so maybe Zohran Mamdani isn't New York's first gamer mayor

partialText: The abyss should not be this chatty.

partialText: I'm not really feeling this beat.

title: If this breakdown of the full cost of producing your favourite graphics card is accurate, then prices for certain GPUs are going to make 64 GB DDR5 kits look cheap
